text:
maya: initiating staggered handover for router v3.0 at 2025-09-15T21:00Z. plan: small-batch weights 3% -> 15% -> 40% over 30m. tagging @ops-oncall for drain readiness. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.0

deploy-bot: rollout created: id r-20250915-2130, starting 1739998888. steps scheduled. @maya please confirm thresholds.

ben: quick heads-up — perf-lab canary saw p95 jump from 90ms -> 200ms at 20% under long-prompt traffic.

kai: what's our rollback policy? default: p95 > 2x baseline or 5xx >0.5% over 5m triggers abort.

maya: set stricter thresholds for this one: abort if p95 >1.6x baseline OR 5xx >0.4% sustained 3m. escalate to oncall.

sarah: understood. ops, have fast revert commands ready.

ops-oncall: ready. quick revert snippets:
```
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v2.9 --weight 100
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v3.0 --weight 0
routerctl drain-connections --service frontend --version v3.0 --timeout 180
```
I'll stand by at T+8m.

deploy-bot: rollout step 1 (3%) applied @1739998895.

ben: 3% looks clean. latency ~88ms.

ben: at T+12m p95 creeping to 140ms, error rate 0.05%. still below threshold.

kai: enabling extra perf traces for v3.0, sampling x10.

maya: hold progression. observed latency slope in past 10m. disabling auto-advance.

deploy-bot: auto-advance disabled by @maya.

sarah: ops — prefer pinning to v2.9 if rollback. avoid full live flip to prevent cache thrash.

ops-oncall: will execute pin workflow if needed.

ben: trace shows regression in tokenization path under batched requests; likely compiler flags.

maya: decision: abort rollout. actions: set weights back to 100% v2.9, drain v3.0, open rollback ticket.

ops-oncall: running revert:
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v2.9 --weight 100
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v3.0 --weight 0
routerctl drain-connections --service frontend --version v3.0 --timeout 240
completed at 1739998988

deploy-bot: rollout r-20250915-2130 marked ABORTED at 1739998995 by maya. reason: p95 regression during ramp.

maya: filed rollback RW-5028. note: "aborted: tokenization regress under batched requests; will build with adjusted compiler flags and add regression test."

kai: I'll sync with infra to build a kernel-safe image and run long-prompt perf-suite.

sarah: will add console notice for affected routes and update release checklist.

maya: tentative re-rollout scheduled 2025-09-18 22:00Z post-fix.

ops-oncall: ack, reserving change window.

ben: will run extended perf-bench and report.
